live_divergence_note.universe: Live scans the dynamic RS-ranked universe (universe.py, top_n=8, weekly rebalance), NOT the 12 tickers in frozen.tickers. Those 12 are the OOS validation universe only. Chosen deliberately; universe_backtest.py measures the rule point-in-time.
live_divergence_note.atr_stop: Live now matches frozen.atr_stop=1.25. It had drifted to 1.0, which the harness never tested and which is the looser setting since R:R scales inversely with it.
live_divergence_note.why_this_note: The atr_stop discrepancy went unnoticed because nothing recorded which value was chosen or why. Anything that diverges from frozen{} belongs here, dated.
